opportunities.title: Henry Moore Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to UK‑based non‑profit organisations with a focus on sculpture projects. Categories include New Projects and Commissions, Acquisitions, Conservation, Research and Travel, etc.
opportunities.summary: Grants supporting non‑profit organisations to deliver sculpture‑related projects. Four application rounds per year, each open for one month.

opportunities.title: Visiting research fellowships

amount.raw: UK – up to £600; Europe – up to £700; Rest of world – up to £1,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to academics, curators, artists and researchers working on historic or contemporary sculpture, with specific streams for Henry Moore‑related research.
opportunities.summary: Month‑long fellowships providing access to the Henry Moore Institute’s research facilities, accommodation and travel/subsistence allowances.
